title: Native relay Wake RPC waits for provider startup after durable queue admission
outcome: Separate the durable metadata Wake response from local provider startup while retaining exact-head authority and idempotent admission.
acceptance: A Wake response can confirm durable metadata/queue admission without waiting for provider startup and never claims runtime acceptance from that response.
A deterministic delayed-provider control preserves exact-owner draining, Stop/cancellation/authority checks, duplicate suppression and fair progress for unrelated targets.
